# Scheduling Model

## Purpose
The Scheduling Model defines entities for time-based scheduling of actions, including recurring slots and specific time-of-day definitions.

## Key Entities
- **Schedule**: Defines when actions should occur.
- **ScheduleAction**: The task to be executed.
- **ScheduleTimeslot**: A specific time window within a schedule.
- **TimeOfTheDayName**: Named time periods (e.g., "Morning", "Evening").

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Schedule
    Baseclass <|-- ScheduleAction
    Baseclass <|-- ScheduleTimeslot
    Baseclass <|-- ScheduleToAction

    Schedule "1" *-- "many" ScheduleTimeslot
    Schedule "1" *-- "many" ScheduleToAction
    ScheduleToAction "many" -- "1" ScheduleAction

    class Schedule {
        +String name
        +OffsetDateTime startTime
        +OffsetDateTime endTime
    }
    class ScheduleTimeslot {
        +DayOfWeek dayOfWeek
        +LocalTime startTime
        +LocalTime endTime
    }
    class ScheduleAction {
        +String name
    }
```
